name: cavemio-verify-code
title: Verify code
description: A one-time code step with a carrier pigeon: Coo naps through the resend wait with the seconds in a thought bubble, and flies every new code to your mailbox.

files.content:
/* Coo's art: an illustrated carrier pigeon, his mailbox and his post, as WebP data URIs so
 * one install brings everything. His flight is in coo-fly-art.ts. Sizes and points are in each image's own pixels. */

export const COO_ART = {
  stand:
    "data:image/webp;base64,",
  box: "data:image/webp;base64,",
  boxFlag:
    "data:image/webp;base64,",
  post: "data:image/webp;base64,",
};

export const COO_GEO = {
  /** Every pigeon frame is placed by the middle of his red cap, so swapping frames never jumps. */
  stand: {
    ...{ w: 186, h: 185 },
    cap: { x: 145.7, y: 17.4 },
    feet: { x: 115.8, y: 183 },
    eye: { x: 152.8, y: 38.8, r: 6.6 },
  },
  box: { ...{ w: 110, h: 151 }, foot: { x: 52.8, y: 151 } },
  boxFlag: { ...{ w: 108, h: 166 }, foot: { x: 51.1, y: 166 } },
  post: { w: 41, h: 131 },
  /** His feathers by the eye, for the lid when he blinks. */
  lid: "rgb(124 131 154)",
} as const;

cavemio.accessibility:
- The code field is Code input: one real input with autocomplete="one-time-code", so SMS autofill, paste and password managers work; its label and status line say what happened.
- The countdown’s digits (in the bubble and the resend line) are hidden from screen readers; they hear that a resend is coming and when it’s sent or failed.
- Coo is decoration (aria-hidden). He, the mailbox and the post are illustrations in coo-art.ts and his flight is wingbeat loops cut from generated animations in coo-fly-art.ts (WebP data URIs, about 55KB together), so the install is complete; his nods, nap, blink, z’s and the mailbox flag are code.
- One frame loop outside React moves him and sleeps when he’s still; his breathing is a compositor animation. The scene is drawn at 364 × 176 and scaled to the stage.
- With reduced motion he doesn’t fly or nod: the flag and his pose change in place.
- Built from Code input, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: destination
props.description: – · Where the code went, shown in the line under the title.

props.name: onVerify
props.description: – · Check the code. Resolve (or return true) to accept; return false or throw for a wrong code.

props.name: onResend
props.description: – · Send a new code. Return { retryAfter } in seconds to set the next wait; throw if it didn’t go.

props.name: channel
props.description: "email" · The title says inbox or number.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: 30 · Seconds before the first resend, and between resends when onResend doesn’t say.

props.name: title / name / autoFocus
props.description: "Check your inbox" / "Coo" / false · The heading, the pigeon’s name in his lines, and whether the code field takes focus on mount.

features.title: Real code input
features.description: One input with one-time-code autofill, paste and the numeric keyboard; the boxes are only what you see.

features.title: A wait you can see
features.description: Coo naps through the resend wait with the seconds rolling down in a thought bubble over his head.

features.title: Your server’s wait
features.description: onResend can return { retryAfter } and the next clock uses it.

features.title: Sends that fail
features.description: If onResend throws, Coo comes back with the envelope and Resend turns into Try again.

features.title: Wrong and right
features.description: A wrong code shakes and clears the boxes; the right one closes them into a pill with a drawn check.

features.title: Email or text
features.description: channel sets the wording (inbox or number), and Change lets people fix the address.

states.title: napping
states.description: Coo stands on his post at the left of the lit stage, the red mailbox with its flag up at the right and his dashed route between them. While the resend clock runs he dozes: his eye shuts, a z drifts up from his cap every 1.1s, and a thought bubble rolls the seconds down; the line reads “Coo is catching his breath”.

states.title: typing
states.description: Typing wakes him for 4s (“Coo is reading along”): each digit rises into its box and he nods forward from his feet.

states.title: checking
states.description: With every box full the row carries a sweep of light and the line reads “Coo is checking”.

states.title: wrong
states.description: onVerify returns false or throws: Coo shakes his head, the boxes shake, turn red and clear from the right; the line reads “Not the code Coo carried”.

states.title: right
states.description: The boxes close into one pill with a drawn check, Coo puffs his chest with two flaps and a hop, and the resend line folds away; “Signed for. You’re in.”

states.title: ready
states.description: At zero the bubble shrinks away into a blur, he wakes with a hop, the line reads “Coo is ready to fly again” and “Resend in 0:00” turns into Resend code.

states.title: resend
states.description: Coo takes off with an envelope (1s along the route, with real wingbeats), waits over the mailbox until onResend settles, pops the flag and flies home empty; Sent, then the clock starts again.

states.title: send failed
states.description: onResend throws: he turns back with the envelope still in his beak, the line says “Coo couldn’t get through” and Resend shakes into Try again.
